reason: I keep losing track of which roles need follow-up, and a free tracker that runs on my laptop sounds worth trying. The script makes setup seem more manageable, though I would stick to the keyless sources and stop if Docker or extra costs become a hassle.
objection: I still have to install Docker and maintain a self-hosted app, and I cannot tell how much setup that really takes.
would_change_my_mind: A short setup video showing the app running on an ordinary student laptop and tracking one application, with no paid keys needed.
